title: Odile and the Spire
author: Emrys Sterling
blurb: Jude Joubert, the youngest member of a dying guild, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then the crown announces a hunt for anyone with the gift — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the usurper's armies reach the free cities.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
